# interval overlaps

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalOverlaps`](gmeow-intervalOverlaps.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalOverlaps>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

Allen OVERLAPS: this interval begins before and ends during the related interval. NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalOverlappedBy`](gmeow-intervalOverlappedBy.md). (= [time:intervalOverlaps](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalOverlaps))
